scope: New Ed25519 baseline using pinned Dalek 2.2.0/curve25519-dalek 4.1.3 serial64 backend; source, portable reference and managed binding

validation.additional_cases: OpenSSL 64KiB message and aliased read-only arguments; error recovery; null empty inputs; native input immutability and untouched error output

review_conclusions: Canonical A/R, on-curve/non-small-order checks and S<L precede the same uncofactored equation used by Dalek verify_strict. No cofactor-only acceptance introduced by using ordinary verify after explicit guards.
Mixed-order keys remain supported as documented: validation is not prime-subgroup membership. Eight valid mixed-order signatures and eight cofactor-only signatures distinguish these contracts.
Compiler allocates managed outputs before borrowing input pointers; synchronous stack-only runtime has no host callback, input mutation, retained state or allocator.
SigningKey and ExpandedSecretKey use upstream zeroize-on-drop. Public API does not promise erasing caller-owned immutable seed or all hash temporaries.
